Observed support effort was 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile; 3 of 45 workspaces exceeded 90 minutes, and no unsupported case entered the admitted path. This is descriptive evidence for the checklist-exposed cohort, not proof that the checklist reduced support effort: there was no randomized control or counterfactual comparison, so causal improvement cannot be attributed to the checklist.
